message_analysis: Crystal clear single message: AI won't kill jobs—it will concentrate wealth and power among the 20% who master it. Every scene reinforces this thesis. Scene 1 hooks with shock, Scene 2 reframes the threat, Scenes 3-5 build the actionable framework (creators, prompters, output owners → position now), Scene 6 loops back to prove the hook delivered. The angle is genuinely original—flipping a fear narrative into a power-positioning play. This would resonate and drive shares because it answers 'how do I survive?' not just 'panic.'
scroll_stop_analysis: Hook is lethal. 'Elon just said 80% of jobs disappear. But nobody's talking about what he said NEXT.' Combined with the kinetic text explosion and Musk thumbnail, this hits all three levers (authority + fear + secret knowledge). Pacing is tight—no dead air. Pattern interrupts sustained throughout (avg 2.5 per scene). Emotion arc peaks at Scene 5 (wealth visualization) and pays off in Scene 6 (loop/revelation). Feels native—voiceover is conversational, visuals are TikTok-native (text slams, split screens, reaction cam), no lecture feel. At 32s, dead in the sweet spot. First 1.5s (Scene 1) absolutely stops a scroller.
